svg.title: RunyShark — Sergio Dario Moreno
svg.desc: RunyShark — Sergio Dario Moreno, Principal Engineer and AI expert. Principal Engineer, AI Architect, Multi-Agent Systems, Engineering Leader. Status: Orchestrating 100+ AI agents in production. Based in Mexico (UTC−6). A dot-matrix RunyShark wordmark over drifting clouds and an AI neural constellation: agent nodes linked by faint edges, data pulses travelling between them, a starfield and rising sparks. Terminal taglines: orchestrate --agents 100+ --parallel --verify / Claude Code · Codex · MCP · agent harnesses / RAG · embeddings · vector search · evals / Leading 60 engineers, prompt to production / Clean Architecture · DDD · SOLID, at scale. Stats: 7+ years shipping, 60 engineers led, 100+ agents in parallel, 57K+ commits, 225 repositories.
